Hello @lilitkarapetyan  - I just tried to reproduce @Tristina1788 steps in the deployment for this PR, as follows:
- go into admin pages
- edit wargame `P10 test`
- add a custom channel (click on a `Add channel`)
- name the channel as `Umpire notes`
- specify a `Request infra` template for `umpire` forces
- save the channel
- go back to player login page
- login as `Game Designer`
- close the `tour` popup
- game crashes, white screen.  Console log below.

Note: in this wargame, we're taking the template(s) from inside the wargame document, not the separate `message_types.sqlite` file.

issues.title: Can't play game with role 'Game control' with channel has config with template
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
Setup new game with channel using template. Notice play game with role 'Game Control' will show white screen and can't play game anymore

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Login app as admin
2. Create a new game
3. From 'Forces' tab, create some forces ( White, Blue, Red)
4. From 'Channels' tab, create channel 1 with some participant rows which using template > Save Channel
5.  Go to 'game play' page
6. Select wargame is the game which is created above
7. Select role 'Game Control' 
8. Click 'Enter'
9. Notice it shows white screen and can not play game

Note: The issue is not happened when channels don't have any participants using template
See below screencast for more details

## ⚙️ Expected behavior
Should show the screen for playing game

## 🖥️ Screencasts

https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/e9ae606a-fab3-4829-a200-e76061dcbf8a


## 💻 System information
Browser : Chrome
Browser Version : Version 120.0.6099.111


## 📝 Additional context
@lilitkarapetyan - I suspect this is another "template not found" issue. Could it be related to the refactoring when we reduced the complexity of `participant states`?

comments.body: Hello @Tristina1788 - No, I think it cannot be related to the changes made.

issues.title: No input field for ' NEW MESSAGE' in game play page
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
Play a game with White - Game Control, I don't see the input field for 'NEW MESSAGE' part

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Create a basic game as this diagram

![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/20433cf8-7b2c-467d-aab4-d94e22f2c87c)

2. Go to 'game play' page
4. Select wargame is the game which is created from step1
5. Select role White - Game Control
6. Click 'Enter'
7. Close the guide
8. Click 'NEW MESSAGE' to open this part
9. Notice no input field for input message

![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/efb769f3-8ff7-4206-9496-e85d9944b8bd)

## ⚙️ Expected behavior
'NEW MESSAGE' should show the input field for input message
